EdTech companies sell learning outcomes and must prove them: engagement-to-evidence loops, content ops at scale, assessment integrity and institutional procurement gates. Product velocity matters, but evidence velocity closes renewals.

items: Engagement metrics ≠ learning proof; renewals wobble.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Lakehouse Architecture & Migration, Master Data, Governance & Cataloging, Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Learning analytics, Content operations, Assessment integrity) on Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/COPPA/GDPR-K among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Lakehouse the right way: Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: SIS/LMS/support data unified with outcome lineage (intervention targeting measurable). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
